authorization: User authorized geometry-centered E105 posttraining with reference weights10% (position .1,shape .025), strict immediate Loss-explosion termination, direct background launch after preparation
scope: one E105 best58 warm posttrain candidate; new fixed geometry Loss, strict explosion stop; normal early-stop then same dev500 depth evaluation, report and stop
initialization: E105 frozen best58 model tensors only; new Loss stage, fresh AdamW/RNG/order/counters and LR1e-4; parent optimizer/budget not inherited; original evidence protected
data: reference_workset_v6 frozen train first32000; original v5 first16000 nested unchanged; identical module-count histogram; prior E58/E74/E101 expansion exposure, not new unseen data
precision: FP32, deterministic algorithms, no AMP or numerical-path changes inside run
cublas_workspace_config: :4096:8, set at package import before CUDA initialization
optimizer: AdamW weight_decay0.0003, global gradient clip1; per-module joint proposed-update bound0.005
loss: registered E107 fixed union-area geometry objective; reference position .1 shape .025; fixed train500 normalization; soft/wire preservation and E105 local trust
selection: same fixed per-case total for backward/train500/dev500; best, LR and early stop use dev500 arithmetic mean per current protocol; train plateau reported independently, dev early-stop is not proof of train convergence
engine: registered FP32 CUDA graph: frozen-parent eval + student deterministic trust forward + student Dropout forward/backward, existing AdamW and projection; CPU cache/pinned batches
network_ports: per-module total weight and weighted centroid only; full port edges used only in loss
stop: STOP file or SIGINT: finish accepted update, save exact latest and exit; no next phase; budget exhaustion distinct from convergence

numerical_guards.nonfinite: any model output, Loss term or gradient norm aborts before AdamW
numerical_guards.relative_batch: max(3*same-frozen-parent batch mean, parent batch mean+5)
numerical_guards.relative_case: max(10*same-frozen-parent case Loss, parent case Loss+20)
numerical_guards.action: immediately reject update, save failure diagnostics and latest/best, write STOP, stop controller and forbid evaluation; no skip, retry or automatic LR reduction

postprocessing_calls: 500 terminal dev500 only; no training feedback

augmentation.seed_rule: SeedSequence([20261104,seed,epoch]); member-index flags; independent sampling and Dropout streams
augmentation.monitoring: unaugmented original train500/dev500, eval mode; same fixed per-case Loss

numerical_path: new registered gated full pre-norm and SwiGLU architecture, same FP32 backward/AdamW/projection engine and numerical guards

comparison.interpretation: E107 warm stage changes Loss, compare new-Loss parent epoch0 and candidate; old E105 Loss not directly comparable; terminal same dev500/solver, no Q reselection
comparison.loss: same original fixed ten E104 coefficients, not E103 learned coefficients
comparison.metrics: same fixed train500/dev500 Loss, absolute and relative gaps; unique best terminal threeQ, raw/final legality, overlap/bbox, full mean/P95/max latency and >250ms; cold/disk/bulk separate

latest_authorization: 2026-11-05 user: reference10%, strict Loss explosion detection and immediate abort, prepare and background-start
gates: one sigmoid scalar per layer per attention/local/FFN/geometry branch, initialized .1, no scan
ffn: SwiGLU middle width256=2*width; ffn_dropout .10 after gated product, residual_dropout .05 on each attention/local/FFN message; geometry feedback has no additional Dropout
geometry_feedback: shared Linear3->128, SiLU, Linear128->128, then per-layer geometry LayerNorm and gate; state masked as E104
head: shared head preceded by dedicated shared LayerNorm; same unconstrained3 state and public decoder

geometry_loss.normalization: means over unaugmented frozen train_monitor500 from E105 best58, fixed before training; three scaled main terms weight1 each
geometry_loss.soft: original 2B shared-denominator soft + 2*sum normalized squared upper-bound violations; bound=max(frozen-parent same-case raw boundary/group/mib, [.01,.01,.0025])
geometry_loss.wire: original .5B wirelength + squared ratio excess above1.05*parent wire (floor1e-4)
geometry_loss.trust: deterministic eval-mode student vs frozen eval parent, centers radius .1*sqrt(area), log-aspect radius .1; mean squared hinge beyond radius; weight1
geometry_loss.exactness: rectangle event-grid area/coverage differentiable almost everywhere; only threshold-count smoothed; no raster proxy

dropout_and_trust: same FFN.1/residual.05 and 50%axis-swap; main geometry/reference/soft terms use training Dropout output; trust alone uses clean eval-mode student so unchanged E105 does not incur drift from Dropout
sort_backward_implementation: detached stable argsort + explicit permutation bmm; same sorted values and a.e. gradient, avoids native deterministic sort scatter during graph capture; train500 scales reused without refit
